items.detail: A directory of ESS documents is compiled by ess-compiler to the resolved IR; a document ESS refuses is refused with ESS's diagnostics.
items.label: Load and compile

items.detail: Entities need store.durable, periodic bindings timer and clock, cross-component bindings channel, external outcomes external.<command>.<outcome>.
items.label: Derived from the specification

items.detail: capabilities --component lists only what one component needs when it runs on its own.
items.label: Per component

items.detail: Each required capability is bound to the first implementation the environment lists for it; an exact key wins over a prefix key.
items.label: Bind by preference

items.detail: A refused admission names every capability without an implementation and exits 3.
items.label: Refusal names what is missing

items.detail: spindle-kernel selects the outcome by the IR's conditions and guards, applies its effect and emits its events; b10x-spindle run reads commands as JSON lines.
items.label: Commands against the compiled model

items.detail: The store follows the store.durable binding; SQLite state survives a restart.
items.label: Memory and SQLite stores

items.detail: spindle-timer yields due ticks for periodic bindings on an injected clock, honouring the ESS periodic profile.
items.label: Periodic bindings

items.detail: spindle-channel carries an event to the command it binds to, in process or as length-prefixed JSON frames over TCP; at_least_once redelivers.
items.label: Event bindings in process and over TCP

items.detail: An on_failure: retry binding runs its command again at once after each refused or failed attempt, up to 5 attempts, before the next envelope runs; each attempt and each given-up invocation is counted. --drop-retries runs such a binding as a drop binding.
items.label: Retry on failure

items.detail: b10x-spindle play runs the three rally components in one process with in-process channels until a side wins.
items.label: Every component in one process

items.detail: Placement refuses an instance above its target's ceiling; the process launcher starts and stops an instance and reports its exit.
items.label: The target contract and the process launcher

items.detail: A library launcher: one qemu-system-x86_64 -M microvm per instance with KVM, without root. Its tests run on a host with /dev/kvm (task check:vm), not in CI.
items.label: QEMU microvm launcher

items.detail: A library launcher: Firecracker VMs on a bridge inside a user and network namespace, without root. Its tests need /dev/kvm, the Firecracker binary and a guest kernel (task check:vm), not in CI.
items.label: Firecracker launcher

items.detail: run --decisions answers external outcomes from a TOML file, per command or for all; --answer-default takes a command's default branch.
items.label: External decisions from a file

items.detail: A creation whose identity no input or payload supplies needs identity.mint; a Uuid identity is minted as a UUIDv4, a String newtype identity as its prefix and a UUIDv4's text, and emitted.
items.label: Minted creation identities

items.detail: List views over every instance of an entity, with a state filter and an order.
items.label: List views with filters

items.detail: spindle-telemetry counts commands by outcome, events, bindings, timer ticks and store writes per component; b10x-spindle metrics prints the catalogue, play prints the table's counters.
items.label: Counters derived from the specification

items.detail: Launchers read CPU seconds and resident memory per instance from /proc and its share of the requested quota.
items.label: Host-side resource sampling

items.detail: An instance that starts the spindle-telemetry sender sends its cumulative counters and its own resource readings as spindle-telemetry/1 frames every second, over a Unix socket for a process and vsock for QEMU and Firecracker, and drops and counts frames no collector takes.
items.label: Telemetry transport

items.detail: The spindle.observe domain specifies the API answers; their JSON Schema, Rust and TypeScript types are generated and drift-checked.
items.label: The observe API contract

items.detail: A Vue 3 app in ui/ with topology, instance and view screens, built and tested on fixture answers; no live data until the control process exists.
items.label: The observe UI, on fixtures

items.detail: Three b10x-spindle play --component processes, one per component, started by the process launcher from its SPINDLE_* variables and joined by TCP channels, play a match to a winner; each sends its telemetry when given an endpoint.
items.label: Three processes

items.detail: Each rally component in its own microVM, one b10x-spindle play per VM in its per-component mode, joined by TCP channels across the VM network, plays a match to a winner; one placement (examples/rally/placement.toml) runs on QEMU and on Firecracker. Its tests run on a host with /dev/kvm (task check:vm), not in CI.
items.label: Three microVMs

items.detail: run serves the accepted commands and views over HTTP on 127.0.0.1 where ingress.network is bound to http-loopback: at the routes ess generate --kind openapi publishes, with or without an ess-http/1 binding, answering the envelope ESS publishes.
items.label: HTTP ingress

items.detail: A loopback run also serves GET /api/model (the IR as ess specify compile prints it, and each outcome's subject), GET /api/events (every event published, in order) and POST /api/reset (empties every store); a route the binding or ESS publishes at one of those paths is refused at startup.
items.label: Console routes

items.detail: An HTTP run serves every command and view that runs and answers each other one 501 naming the construct, ESS's envelope for a command; the list is printed at startup, in name order. A view the ingress cannot route still refuses startup by name, since ESS publishes no 501 for a view. SQLite state without --state is kept in a temporary directory removed when the run ends.
items.label: Serve what runs

items.detail: run --scenario replays an ess-scenario document through ESS's reader and conformance runner: captures feed later steps, view asserts are checked, and the first divergent step is named and ends the run.
items.label: Scenario replay

items.detail: conform runs the suite ESS synthesises from a specification, or one written for it, against every component in one process; task check runs it on Spindle's own specification, lists every synthesis refusal with its code and holds the executed and skipped counts.
items.label: Self-conformance

items.detail: b10x-spindle deploy places and launches instances, collects their samples and serves the read-only observe API on 127.0.0.1; the UI then shows live data and is embedded in the binary.
items.label: The control process

items.detail: Upload a bundle to deploy it; design milestone M4, no story yet.
items.label: Bundle, deploy service and registry

items.detail: Cells across threads, ownership leases with fencing, snapshots; design milestone M5, no story yet.
items.label: Cells, ownership and snapshots
